title: Article 278 — Agreement with States in Part B of the First Schedule with regard to certain financial matters (Omitted)

content.overview: Article 278 authorised agreements with States in Part B of the First Schedule on certain financial matters. It was omitted by the Constitution (Seventh Amendment) Act, 1956 (w.e.f. 1 November 1956) when Part B States ceased as a constitutional class.
content.glance: Art 278 omitted by 7th Amendment 1956 (w.e.f. 1-11-1956). Part B financial-agreement provision removed.
content.study:
Article 278 was a transitional/financial arrangement for Part B States.

Omission: Constitution (Seventh Amendment) Act, 1956 (w.e.f. 1-11-1956).

Examination rule: Do not cite Article 278 as living law. Current Centre–State financial arrangements are under Part XII and Finance Commission framework.

questionsAndAnswers.question: What is the status of Article 278?
questionsAndAnswers.answer: Article 278 was omitted by the Constitution (Seventh Amendment) Act, 1956 (w.e.f. 1-11-1956). It is not living law.

distinctions.title: Scope of art-278
distinctions.body: Applies only within the elements and consequences stated in the constitutional text.
